30.    RESOLUTION Amending City provided health insurance related benefits for specified
                       —




       permanent part-time City employees and members of the City Council of the City of
       Cheyenne. (SPONSORS DR. ALDRICH AND MR. MOODY)
                                —




Mr. Moody moved to adopt. Motion died due to the lack of a second.

Dr. Michelle Aldrich, Councilmember Ward III and co-sponsor of the item, provided background
information related to health insurance benefits provided to City Council members and advised on
the proposed changes to how benefits would be paid should the proposed resolution be adopted.
Upon inquiry, Darrin Hass, Human Resources Director, provided information related to part-time
employee wages. Tom Segrave, 2026 City Council President, commented on the item.

31.    LEASES/CONTRACTS/LEGAL:

       d)     Purchase and Sale Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and Nick and April
              Ferrulli, do NAS Investment Group, LLC for property located at 803 West I 6th
              Street, 1510 Reed Avenue, 1508 Reed Avenue and 1506 Reed Avenue for
              Greenway and Compliance use. (2021 Specific Purpose Option Tax Fund and
              General Fund)

Mr. Moody moved to approve in an amount not to exceed $650,000.00, seconded by Mr. Wolfe.
Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.

Jean Shrednik, Parks & Greenway Planner, provided a staff report and Eric Fountain, Compliance
Director, provided additional information. Committee members Moody, Wolfe and White
commented on the item. Councilman Pete Laybourn, Ward I, commented on the item and public
comments were made by Sophia Maes, Downtown Development Authority Director, and Charles
Miller.

       e)     Drainage Easement Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and Christopher C.
              Post and Deborah L. Post, Trustees of the Post Revocable Trust for a recently
              constructed stormwater detention pond.

Mr. Wolfe moved to approve, seconded by Mr. Moody. Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.

Erin Gates, Ph, Staff Engineer, provided a staff report and committee member Wolfe commented
on the item.

       f)     Professional Services Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and WM Recycle
              America, LLC for Recycling Services for the City of Cheyenne Sanitation Division.
              (Solid Waste Fund)

Mr. Wolfe moved to approve in an amount not to exceed $750,000.00 for the term of 3 years,
seconded by Mr. White. Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.
